cases.task: Start a fresh simulated cluster with no jobs and both cpu-1 and gpu-1 idle. Use the copied cluster.json, master_private.json and phd_private.json synthetic fixtures. Run the existing T1_priority_queue scenario with the explicit DeterministicBackend offline fixture: Master and PhD each submit their fixture CPU request; Professor reviews and schedules them; the simulator issues completion receipts and the students report completion.
cases.expected_outcome: No execution error. Exactly two jobs exist, owned by Master and PhD, and both are COMPLETED. Every node has run_id null at the end.
involved_policies: Exercises approval before dispatch and a simulator receipt before task completion.
Exercises the normal QUEUED to RUNNING to COMPLETED lifecycle and final release of allocations.
The native scenario exercises PhD waiting-queue priority; the completion checker checks final completion rather than certifying scheduling-policy compliance.
